cast.name: Narrator
cast.role: the analytical voice explaining cognitive systems and memory architecture; never staged as a person
cast.look: Off-screen explanatory voice framing mnemonic techniques, drawn as a clean neutral presence.

cast.name: Kevin Horsley
cast.role: the author and memory grandmaster who broke the World Memory Championship record reciting 10,000 digits of Pi
cast.look: Kevin Horsley, a sharp man in his early 40s, athletic build, short dark hair, wearing a clean navy casual blazer over a grey t-shirt, focused and deliberate expression.

cast.name: Everyman learner
cast.role: a professional or everyday person struggling with information overload, forgotten names, and mental clutter
cast.look: A professional in their mid 30s, average build, brown hair, wearing a casual crewneck sweater and dark trousers, looking intently at learning material.

cast.name: Mnemonic practitioner
cast.role: a student actively practicing the loci method and visualizing absurd imagery along physical routes
cast.look: A young adult in their 20s, slim build, wavy dark hair, wearing a light jacket over a graphic tee, actively visualizing and gesturing with focus.
